item.title: Russia’s “Dandelion” Tank Could Be Effective at Countering Drones
item.description: Unlike past instances of ineffective shielding, Russia’s "dandelion" tank armor appears to be useful against FPV drones—and aids in the vehicle’s camouflage as well. The post Russia’s “Dandelion” Tank Could Be Effective at Countering Drones appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: The UK Won’t Commit to Sending Challenger 2 Tanks to Ukraine
item.description: As the British Army prepares to replace its aging—but still effective—Challenger 2 tanks with newer Challenger 3 ones, no determination has yet been made on what to do with them. The post The UK Won’t Commit to Sending Challenger 2 Tanks to Ukraine appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: Would a Trump Greenland Takeover Really ‘End’ NATO?
item.description: Trump’s threats to annex Greenland have been widely criticized within the United States, with one Republican lawmaker calling the proposal "weapons-grade stupid." The post Would a Trump Greenland Takeover Really ‘End’ NATO? appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: Trump Wants You (and America’s Enemies) to See the E-4B Doomsday Plane
item.description: The E-4B Nightwatch’s visit to Los Angeles came amid Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth’s “Arsenal of Freedom” tour—intended to display America’s military might both to its citizens and its adversaries. item.title: The Battle for Greenland Is Now Being Fought in Congress
item.description: Two competing proposals for Greenland have been introduced in the US House of Representatives—one giving Trump the authority to annex the island, the other explicitly forbidding it. The post The Battle for Greenland Is Now Being Fought in Congress appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: America’s Special Forces Are Caught Up in the AI Craze
item.description: Special Operations Command hopes that AI can help during night raids—when it can quickly process information extracted from target sites, allowing for faster subsequent raids. The post America’s Special Forces Are Caught Up in the AI Craze appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: Congratulations, Putin: The Ukraine War Has Now Lasted Longer than World War II
item.description: Russia has lost around 1.2 million soldiers during the Ukraine War—a number that pales in comparison to its losses during the “Great Patriotic War” from 1941 to 1945. The post Congratulations, Putin: The Ukraine War Has Now Lasted Longer than World War II appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: Why Sweden Is Building Out a Homegrown Drone Force
item.description: Sweden has committed hundreds of millions of dollars to strengthening its drone force and its space capabilities—both of which will be crucial in any future NATO war. The post Why Sweden Is Building Out a Homegrown Drone Force appeared first on The National Interest.
